agent_priors_used: General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a benchmark whose comparator arms sit at a correctness ceiling cannot establish a success-rate or cost advantage, so dynamic range and a treatment/comparator distinction must be engineered and verified before any treatment comparison - this is why the B2 bank and its memoryful robustness matter more than another mechanism variant.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): raising comparator strength (native caching / goal-addressing baselines such as exact goal_sig, or Stagehand-like route caching) typically erases apparent reuse gains, so four internal arms alone are insufficient for a market-level moat claim and strong external baselines must be reproduced with their own denominators.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): infrastructure/style prerequisites that recur as MEASUREMENT_INVALID across lanes (a missing second egress, a missing model credential, an unenforced freeze gate) should be resolved once as a substrate/ops repair instead of being rediscovered per lane.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): an idle or tunnel-flagged lane needs an explicit continue/park decision rather than inertia, because unattended exploration tends toward local optima and path dependence.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): completing an already-designed measurement of a previously BLOCKED question has higher information value than opening a fresh mechanism family in the same basin (stability of the question beats novelty of the substrate).

allocation.rationale: Runtime is the only IDLE lane (active_experiment_id null) and must be explicitly reactivated rather than left dormant. Its last packet, EXP-RUNTIME-38169622704, discharged the B2 dynamic-range blocker at the SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V2 synthetic ceiling (F1 K=8 comparator 0.875; F2 K=10 comparator 0.900; all validity gates V1-V8 true; audit PASS) but disclosed the NC-MEMORYFUL boundary: a within-session receipt-retaining cold agent reaches 1.0, so the engineered (K-1)/K separation is a construction property that bounds the amortization rate. Decision counterfactual: if the (K-1)/K treatment/comparator separation survives a memoryful comparator, the bank is genuine B2 dynamic range for the gated four-arm benchmark; if the memoryful comparator reaches the treatment level, the certificate is a memoryless-construction artifact and the bank cannot supply discriminative range for that benchmark, which changes how the benchmark must be built. This is the cheapest model-free step that is strictly on the critical path to the one decisive benchmark and it uses the already-frozen construction and counter-only metric. Scope is C-MEAS-VALID (registry owner lane runtime) - a substrate-validity question, not a mechanism claim. Stop trigger: one experiment; if memoryful comparators close the gap, do not re-run the memoryless certificate (three unsatisfiable/deterministic REST iterations already exist) - report the artifact and hand the bank-design question to Product. Separately, and non-experimentally, the shared control-plane defect exposed by EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 (scripts/freeze_experiment.py does not enforce the C1 certificate gate) should be repaired once.

The three verified product blockers are unchanged: B1 (no audited parameterized carrier promoted into src/spider/kernel.py), B2 (benchmark degeneracy - the certified SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V2 bank supplies dynamic range only at a synthetic ceiling with memoryless comparators), and B3 (no capable same-protocol agent endpoint; the credential-free local 3B-8B class was FALSIFIED). Five lanes already hold PREFREEZE experiments that target the correct blocker - Graph=resolve()+abstention, Product=B1 install, Intel=B3 endpoint+comparator reproduction, Physics=vantage orthogonality, Frontier=discovery-attainability v2 - and I do not manufacture pivots against in-flight work that is still strategically correct. Runtime is the only IDLE lane and is explicitly reactivated on the cheapest, most central B2 question (does the (K-1)/K separation survive a memoryful comparator). I cap Physics and Frontier as bounded, self-terminating experiments per the global audit, each with an explicit two-sided stop rule. I explicitly do NOT authorize expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark execution: none of the three readiness conditions holds today (B2 memoryful robustness untested, B1 install in flight, B3 unresolved), so the four-arm benchmark would fail its own gate. Every allocation below states the success/failure/cannot-measure decision counterfactual and a stop trigger; total new spend is six bounded experiments, all pre-freeze.
